Do you like testing complex systems and working closely with developers? We are looking for a Senior QA Engineer to join our Product Extension Team in Copenhagen. You will bring senior test expertise to a small team that builds integrations and extensions for Systematic's defence products, with real influence on how we test and improve.

The job

As the team's senior tester, you will be its quality advocate, driving how we test and improve across the full development lifecycle. You will combine hands-on test execution with real influence over our testing tools, methods and processes.

In short, you can look forward to:

• Planning, estimating and executing test activities, and contributing to test estimates in project planning

• Driving quality across the development lifecycle through risk-based test design

• Developing and maintaining system-level automated tests that support feature testing

• Challenging developers and projects on where automation makes the most sense, including weak points in developer-driven tests

• Improving our test tools, methods and processes

You should expect occasional travel of around five to ten days a year, mostly within Europe. Some onsite hardware testing may also be required, depending on integration needs.

Joining the team

You will be part of the Product Extension Team in Defence Services, around seven developers, test engineers and architects. The team delivers software and hardware integrations such as sensor interfaces, radio drivers and interoperability solutions with external systems, so our customers get functionality tailored to their needs without compromising on quality or maintainability. As the team's senior tester, you will work closely with developers, architects, project management, external system providers and customer representatives, and share your knowledge by mentoring our junior test engineer and running workshops.

Your qualifications

To succeed in this role, you bring solid experience in software and/or systems testing, along with:

• A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Software Technology or similar

• Experience with test management and test design methods

• The ability to drive the implementation of test frameworks and tools, and to review and adapt existing automated test setups

• Familiarity with integrations, APIs, protocols and hardware validation setups

• Experience with tools like JUnit, Cucumber, Playwright, Jira, Xray, Karma and TeamCity, or similar

• Fluent English; Danish is a nice-to-have

ISTQB Foundation certification, or similar, is an advantage but not a requirement.

Alongside this, we value:

• A proactive and independent approach, with strong analytical skills and a risk-based mindset

• An ability to build relationships and work across teams and projects

• Curiosity about customer needs and how the system is actually used

• A willingness to share information openly and help others learn

Please note that you must be able to present a clean criminal record and have lived in a NATO and/or an EU country for the past seven years as we work with security-classified projects. Read more here.

Welcome to Systematic Copenhagen

When you join us in Copenhagen, you're not just getting a desk at one of the city's best locations—you are stepping into a workplace where community matters. Our Employees Club keeps things lively with monthly social events, and our office catering makes sure you are always well taken care of. Whether you are into casual games or just good company, you will find both at our foosball table or during our relaxed Friday bar gatherings.

Never stop developing

Systematic is uniquely people-centric, truly international and proudly rooted in Denmark with more than 1100 employees. Together, we write intelligent and innovative code to drive progress and improve lives. We develop IT solutions that make a real difference where it matters most. This is why we never stop developing. Here, there is room to be professional and personal. It is not just a place to work but a place to belong.

Start your development here

We will be assessing applications on an ongoing basis as we wish to welcome our new colleague as soon as possible, so click Apply Now and send us your CV today. If you have any questions, you are always welcome to contact us on tel. +45 8943 2000 and ask for Andreas Markussen, Senior Manager.

Ambu A/S is looking for a Senior Portfolio Management Consultant to join the Innovation PMO.

You will work with complex, cross-functional topics related to portfolio management, governance and business performance. Your role is to define the problem, build the fact base, align stakeholders, recommend solutions and establish ownership for implementation.

Reporting to the Director, Innovation PMO, you will work closely with colleagues across the PMO and senior stakeholders across Ambu.

We believe the best ideas come from a mix of in-person collaboration and focused individual work. That's why this role is based in Augsburg or Ballerup and follows a hybrid working model, with three days per week in the office and two days working from home.

Key responsibilities

• 
Cross-functional initiatives

• 
Drive selected cross-functional topics from problem definition through analysis, recommendation and stakeholder alignment.

• 
Define decisions, actions and ownership, and hand over execution to the relevant business owner.

• 
Portfolio governance and ways of working

• 
Evaluate and improve processes for project portfolio prioritization, resource management, project governance and performance follow-up.

• 
Translate business goals and requirements and input from subject-matter experts into clear processes, roles, decision criteria and governance.

• 
Analysis and decision support

• 
Analyse portfolio, project, resource and business-performance information to identify issues and recommend actions.

• 
Develop scenarios, recommendations and decision material for senior management.

• 
Management support

• 
Take ownership of selected analyses and cross-functional topics on behalf of the Director, Innovation PMO.

• 
Prepare recommendations, presentation material and follow up agreed actions with relevant stakeholders.

Suggested candidate profile

**Skills

**Skills and experiences can be earned in many different ways, and we understand that the best fit for the role cannot be prescribed on paper. You are likely to succeed in this position if you:

• Have relevant experience within project portfolio management, management consulting, PMO, business transformation or operational excellence.

• Have taken complex, cross-functional business problems from initial question to analysis, recommendation and agreed action.

• Have aligned senior stakeholders across functions, including situations with different priorities and no direct reporting relationship.

• Have hands-on experience with portfolio management, prioritization, governance, resource management and/or performance reporting.

• Have prepared analyses, decision recommendations and presentation material for senior management.

• Can work independently with loosely defined assignments, while knowing when to involve subject-matter experts and decision-makers.

• Communicate clearly and concisely in English, both in writing and presentations.

Experience from MedTech or another regulated industry is an advantage, but not a prerequisite.

**Ambu – a visionary and international workplace where your efforts matter

**Ambu is a company that expands rapidly and has ambitious growth targets. We meet these targets through interdisciplinary teamwork between motivated and highly skilled employees. Your contributions and efforts are crucial to our success and by joining us you will get the opportunity to work in an international head office with an informal working environment.

We offer great opportunities for personal development. Furthermore, we offer a wide range of professional, social and financial employee benefits in addition to exciting job challenges and continuous professional and personal development.

At Elanco (NYSE: ELAN) – it all starts with animals!

As a global leader in animal health, we are dedicated to innovation and delivering products and services to prevent and treat disease in farm animals and pets. At Elanco, we are driven by our vision of Food and Companionship Enriching Life and our purpose – all to Go Beyond for Animals, Customers, Society and Our People.

At Elanco, we pride ourselves on fostering a diverse and inclusive work environment. We believe that diversity is the driving force behind innovation, creativity, and overall business success. Here, you’ll be part of a company that values and champions new ways of thinking, work with dynamic individuals, and acquire new skills and experiences that will propel your career to new heights.

Making animals’ lives better makes life better – join our team today!

Your Role: Marketing Student Assistant

As our Marketing Student Assistant, you'll play a crucial supporting role within the Elanco Pet Health Nordics team, working closely with the Nordic Marketing Manager. This unique opportunity allows you to gain hands-on experience across diverse marketing activities and touchpoints for a broad portfolio of medicinal products in multiple Nordic markets.

Your Responsibilities:

• Coordinate the full process of certain (or relevant) marketing material development, from briefing agencies to proofing and final delivery.

• Support the Marketing Manager in daily marketing tasks and assist with Advertising & Promotion (A&P) cost tracking.

• Manage orders for promotional items, merchandise, and giveaways.

• Maintain and update material inventories and activity plans.

• Contribute to media planning and the development of media assets.

• Take part in coordination and analysis of consumer surveys, market data etc.

What You Need to Succeed (minimum qualifications):

• Education: Currently enrolled in a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Marketing, Communication, Business Administration, or a related field.

• Required Experience: Some prior experience or insight into marketing.

• Top skills: Structured, detail-oriented, and highly organized; Strong written and verbal communication skills in English and at least one Nordic language (Danish, Swedish, or Norwegian).

What will give you a competitive edge (preferred qualifications):

• Prior digital marketing experience.

• A team player with a strong customer focus and a proactive mindset.

• Skilled in Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

• High level of personal accountability and drive to deliver.

• Hands-on experience with campaign planning and execution.

Additional Information:

• Travel: Minimal

• Location: Denmark, Ballerup

• Working hours: Approximately 15 hours per week.

• Start date: As soon as possible.

• Application deadline: Ongoing interviews, apply as soon as possible. Please attach your cover letter as well.

Don’t meet every single requirement?

At Elanco we are dedicated to building a diverse and inclusive work environment. If you think you might be a good fit for a role but don't necessarily meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. You may be the right candidate for this role or other roles!

Please use this application link.

Elanco is an EEO/Affirmative Action Employer and does not discriminate on the basis of age, race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, national origin, protected veteran status, disability or any other legally protected status

Elanco may use automated tools, including AI, to support parts of our recruitment process, such as reviewing applications against job‑related criteria and/or transferrable skills. These tools help ensure a consistent, structured evaluation, but they do not make hiring decisions. All decisions involve a human reviewer. For more information on how we handle personal data, please see our Elanco Workforce Privacy Notice.

**Vice President, Head of Thickening

****Job Description

****Location

**Global

**Reports To

**Product Group Head – Separation

**Role Purpose

**The Head of Thickening role is accountable for the global business performance and growth of the Thickener product offerings across the entire product lifecycle, encompassing both Capital equipment and Upgrades & Rebuilds (U&R).

This role owns the global P&L, commercial strategy, market positioning, pricing strategy, and product roadmap. Responsible for driving aggressive volume growth while protecting and growing profitability targets by maximizing customer value and ensuring a seamless customer offering throughout the lifecycle of installed equipment.

Working across a complex matrix organization, the VP leads the commercialization of both new equipment, upgrades and rebuilds, partnering closely with Capital Sales, Regional Sales, Product Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations and Services, to accelerate growth and create sustainable competitive advantage.

**Executive Profile

**The successful candidate must combine strong commercial leadership with a recognized understanding of thickening technologies and their application in minerals processing.

While supported by a team of product managers, application engineers, and technical experts, the Head of Thickening must possess sufficient technical depth and industry credibility to engage confidently with customers, challenge assumptions, evaluate product strategies, and make informed business decisions. The role requires an executive capable of driving business growth while serving as a trusted authority on the Thickener portfolio across both Capital equipment and lifecycle solutions.

**Key Responsibilities

****Business and P&L Leadership

**

• Own the global P&L for the Thickeners portfolio, including Revenue, Operating Income, Contribution Margin, market share, and profitability.

• Develop and execute the long-term business strategy and growth plan for both Capital and Upgrades & Rebuilds businesses.

• Deliver aggressive growth targets through expansion of equipment sales, modernization programs, and installed-base opportunities.

• Manage business performance through rigorous forecasting, pipeline reviews, financial analysis, and strategic planning.

• Lead and develop a global team of Product Managers, Product Engineers, Applications / Proposals, Technical sales, etc.

• Build a high-performance culture focused on accountability, customer value, growth, and execution.

• Identify and develop new revenue streams, market opportunities, and business models that enhance lifecycle value creation.

**Commercial Leadership

**

• Define and implement global commercial strategies for Capital and U&R offerings.

• Lead the global sales growth agenda by partnering with Capital Sales teams, Regional Sales organizations, and key account leaders.

• Drive pipeline generation, conversion improvement, and sales excellence across all regions.

• Establish and govern global pricing strategies that optimize profitability while maintaining market competitiveness.

• Support major commercial negotiations and customer engagements for strategic opportunities.

• Monitor market dynamics, customer trends, and competitor activities to identify growth opportunities and business risks.

**Upgrades & Rebuilds Growth

**

• Own the global strategy, growth, and profitability of the Upgrades & Rebuilds business within the Thickeners portfolio.

• Develop lifecycle offerings that increase customer productivity, sustainability, and equipment performance.

• Collaborate with regional commercial teams to identify modernization, expansion, and rebuild opportunities across the installed base.

• Establish standardized upgrade packages, retrofit solutions, and value propositions that are scalable globally.

• Drive alignment between global product strategy and regional commercial execution.

**Product and Portfolio Strategy

**

• Define the global product roadmap and lifecycle strategy for the Thickeners portfolio.

• Collaborate with Engineering to prioritize innovation investments and technology development.

• Lead market assessments to identify customer needs, emerging trends, and competitive opportunities.

• Ensure product offerings remain differentiated, profitable, and aligned with market requirements.

• Drive standardization, product optimization, digital offerings, and sustainable technology initiatives.

**Cross-Functional Leadership

**

• Lead and influence a highly matrixed global organization without relying solely on direct authority.

• Partner with Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Services, Finance, and Regional leadership teams to execute business objectives.

• Ensure alignment between commercial commitments, operational capabilities, and customer expectations.

• Support execution excellence throughout the order lifecycle to maximize customer satisfaction and long-term portfolio success.

**Candidate Profile

**The ideal candidate is a commercially driven business leader with deep experience in thickening technology and minerals processing. They have successfully managed a significant product line, business unit, or portfolio with responsibility for growth, profitability, and market strategy. They are equally comfortable discussing thickener performance and applications with customers and engineers as they are leading commercial negotiations, reviewing business performance, and driving strategic growth initiatives.

**Experience

**

• 15+ years of progressive leadership experience within mining, minerals processing, capital equipment, or industrial technology businesses.

• Significant experience with thickening technologies, dewatering solutions, or adjacent process equipment used in mineral processing operations.

• Demonstrated understanding of thickener applications, customer processes, operational challenges, product performance drivers, and aftermarket opportunities throughout the equipment lifecycle.

• Proven success leading a global business, product line, service line, or business unit with accountability for revenue growth and profitability.

• Strong commercial leadership experience, including business development, sales strategy, pricing, market expansion, and P&L ownership.

• Track record of driving growth across both capital equipment sales and aftermarket offerings such as upgrades, rebuilds, modernization programs, and lifecycle services.

• Experience working across highly matrixed global organizations and influencing stakeholders without direct authority.

• Established credibility engaging with customers, engineering teams, technical specialists, and regional commercial organizations at a strategic level.

**Education

**

• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, or a related discipline.

• Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or equivalent preferred.

**Core Competencies

**

• Commercial Leadership

• P&L Management

• Strategic Thinking

• Stakeholder Management

• People Leadership

• Thickening Technology Expertise

• Sales & Business Development

• Lifecycle Solutions Management

• Results orientation

FLSmidth is the leading supplier of engineering, equipment and service solutions to customers in the mining and minerals industries – for more information please visit FLSmidth.com/careers

Join us in this role where you’ll be part of a highly motivated, dynamic and social team focusing on financial lifecycle cost analysis of future and existing offshore wind projects. You’ll obtain key insights into our development pipeline and existing fleet where you will ensure best-in-class financial and investment support for our global offshore organization.

We are looking for an OPEX Financial Analyst with exceptional analytical skills to transform complex datasets into actionable insights. Proficiency in Excel and the ability to present findings clearly to various stakeholders are essential.

**Welcome to Technical Budgeting and Analysis

**You’ll be part of a team where you, together with your colleagues, will develop and benchmark operational lifetime budgets for our existing and future wind farms.

As a team, we will provide all analysis of OPEX cost and support management in taking decisions based on financial and business insights.

**You’ll play an important role in:

**

• taking ownership of your own portfolio of offshore wind projects and the responsibility to support our Offshore business with lifecycle cost assessments and financial analysis

• providing lifecycle cost assessment and financial analysis to our development projects during Bid, FID and maturation phase (incl. risk-, FX- and local content analysis)

• providing relevant high-quality financial analysis on OPEX activities for commercial decision support as well as presenting and reporting to senior management

• working with our M&A Valuation & Structuring team to support our divestment processes through quantitative evaluation of various O&M activities and concepts.

**To succeed in the role, you:

**

• have keen interest in business and cost analysis and are curious to understand fundamental financial drivers behind the business case of an offshore wind farm

• have relevant work experience in the field of lifetime cost modelling, budget forecasting, financial analysis or similar

• thrive in an international, dynamic and fast paced, project environment where you keep the financial overview to ensure the integrity of our business cases and financial commitments

• have a positive can-do attitude and excellent communication skills to ensure complex financial matters are understood by all stakeholders and management

• are highly proficient in Excel and PowerPoint, enjoy working with large financial models and have a proactive mindset towards change.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

**Position salary range:

**For this role, the base pay will be determined according to the relevant pay structure for the location where the position is filled. Actual pay will be based on skills, experience, and the expected role fulfilment to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package. Pay details specific to your location will be provided during the interview process.

**Pre-employment background checks:

**For certain positions, a background check may be required as part of the hiring process. Because we recruit across multiple countries, the specific checks performed will depend on the role and the legal requirements in the location where the position is filled. If a background check is relevant for the role you are being considered for, you will be informed during the recruitment process. All background checks are carried out by an external provider and always in accordance with applicable local laws and regulations.

Are you experienced in JavaScript and TypeScript and ready to take the lead on Front-End development for a fast growing B2B SaaS startup? Then we will be excited to hear from you!

**Who are we?

**Supplios is a fast growing start-up based in Copenhagen, developing an all-in-one supplier portal for global manufacturers.

As a manufacturer it is highly critical to have a streamlined, compliant and data-driven supply chain. However, most manufacturers manage the majority of their supply chain with spreadsheets, e-mails and with no unified system of record for supply chain related data. Where existing tools fall short, Supplios is designed to manage the ever-growing complexities in manufacturing supply chains.

Read more about us here www.supplios.com.

Our Supplier Portal is already used by customers in both the US and Europe and we are seeing a very strong demand from new customers. Therefore, we are looking for a new colleague to take lead of our Front-End architecture and development.

**Skills & Experience

****JavaScript/TypeScript Proficiency:

**

• Strong understanding of JavaScript and TypeScript.

• Ability to write clean, maintainable, and efficient code.

**Framework Experience

**

• Experience with at least one or more JavaScript/TypeScript frameworks such as Vue, React, Angular, Svelte, Next.js, or Nuxt.js.

• Solid understanding of the pros, cons, and tradeoffs of using frameworks, with both client-side and server-side rendering.

**Enterprise Application Experience

**

• Proven experience working on large enterprise applications, demonstrating scalability and maintainability.

• Familiarity with Single Page Applications (SPA), Progressive Web Applications (PWA), and responsive design.

**Testing & Methodologies

**

• Familiarity with Test-Driven Development, Behavior-Driven Development, or Domain-Driven Design.

• Proficiency in writing unit tests, integration tests, and end-to-end tests for JavaScript/TypeScript applications.

• Experience working in an Agile development environment, using practices such as Scrum or Kanban.

**Good to know

**We have a great office in the heart of Copenhagen (Pilestræde) with lunch, great coffee and plenty of space where we would like you to be as much as possible, yet we also support flexible working hours and remote working when this is needed.

To have a good time, supporting each other and delivering a world class product along with a world class customer experience is the core of our DNA, and we expect all our colleagues to contribute in building an incredible company culture.

Everything we build immediately serves real people in real companies worldwide that are making products which affect our daily lives, from cars, to food, renewable energy, and much more.

The role

As our Revenue Operations Manager, you'll own the processes and data behind our sales organization: the sales process, definitions, forecasting and commissions.

This is an individual contributor role in our Revenue Operations team, reporting to the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security. You'll be supported by the RevOps team and work closely with sales leadership and Finance. We're looking for around 5+ years of hands-on experience in VC or PE-backed companies.

What you'll do

Forecasting

• Define shared sales terms and metrics such as pipeline, stage probabilities, bookings, and new versus expansion business.

• Establish a forecasting baseline: forecast categories, submission rules and a first method for new business and expansion.

• Track forecast accuracy and refine the method as data quality improves.

• Build pipeline and forecast reports and dashboards in Salesforce.

• Set up a pipeline and forecast review cadence with sales leadership once the definitions are in place.

Sales process

• Own the sales process from qualified opportunity to closed deal, including stages, exit criteria and the hand-over to delivery and Finance.

• Set up territories, account ownership and rules for partner and cross-sell deals.

Commissions

• Help automate the commission process with the right tooling, from data capture to calculation and payout.

• Work with Finance and sales leadership on plan design and changes.

Sales systems

• Shape how Salesforce (including Revenue Cloud/CPQ) supports the sales process, and make hands-on changes where needed.

• Keep sales data clean with required fields, validation rules and deduplication.

• Automate manual steps in the sales process with workflows and AI.

• Work with CRM vendors and implementation partners, including evaluations, renewals, support and new functionality.

• Train and support sales reps on system and process changes.

Stack harmonization

We grow through acquisition. In October 2026 we announced our combination with WoodWing, adding four products and more than 200 colleagues. Harmonizing the sales stack and processes of acquired companies is a big part of this job, done together with the RevOps team and the Global Director, Revenue Operations & Information Security.

• Bring each acquired sales team, starting with WoodWing, onto our shared sales process, pipeline stages, definitions and reporting.

• Move acquired sales reps onto group commission plans.

• Set account ownership and cross-sell rules between entities, and resolve duplicate accounts.

• Assess each acquired company's sales systems and migrate accounts, contacts, opportunities and products into Salesforce in phases, including from HubSpot.

• Build a repeatable playbook for the next acquisition.

Your qualifications

Essential

• Around 5+ years in Revenue Operations or Sales Operations in B2B SaaS

• Experience building a sales forecast from the ground up, including the definitions and data quality behind it

• Hands-on Salesforce experience, including reports, dashboards and flows

• Experience designing and rolling out sales processes

• Experience administering sales commissions

• Experience consolidating CRMs or sales processes after an acquisition, or running sales operations across several entities

• Good understanding of sales metrics such as pipeline coverage, win rates, sales cycle and bookings

• Strong analytical skills in Excel or Google Sheets

Nice to have

• HubSpot experience, including migrating from HubSpot to Salesforce

• Salesforce Revenue Cloud or CPQ experience

• Experience implementing commission software

• Using AI in sales workflows

Soft skills

You're comfortable with change and ambiguity, as our processes keep developing with each acquisition. You build trust with sales leaders and sales reps, prefer practical solutions you can improve over time, and help new colleagues adapt to shared ways of working.

What kind of company is Omnidocs?

We recognize that in different phases of life, you need different kinds of flexibility, and we are happy to provide that. It could be that you prefer to work from home once or twice a week or occasionally need to leave early for a soccer tournament, a parents’ meeting, or a romantic date. We find small talk between co-workers valuable, so your lunch break is part of your working hours, and we invest in quality coffee beans for the cozy and useful interactions across teams by the coffee machine. It may sound like little things, but the overall message is that we want you to meet trust, kindness, and helpfulness at work because we expect that this is what you bring as well. The purpose of our company is just as internal as it is externally communicated: We make every workday work better.

We also love to connect. We do social activities such as LAN parties, board game afternoons, and Friday Cafes. Our office is located in the heart of the historic neighborhood of Christianshavn, surrounded by canals and great little cafés and restaurants. We have plenty of light and air while being close to everything – including the metro, the canals, and the city center.

How to apply – important information!

As we strive to have an unbiased recruitment process, we ask you to be attentive to the following when applying.

1- Include a resume with relevant professional experience, skillset, and educational background.

2- Answer all required questions in the submission form when uploading.

3- Use the dedicated application link (do not send your resume over e-mail).

4- Do NOT share: a cover letter / motivated application a picture of yourself (if it’s part of your resume, please remove it before uploading) information about your gender or sex your first name (enter the first letter of your first name instead) your age or birth date

Processing of personal data By registering in our HR system, BambooHR, and uploading both application and CV, you accept that Omnidocs stores the registered data about you and the data included in the uploaded documents. All information is used solely for recruitment purposes and will be deleted within 12 months of upload. Please do not include person-sensitive data in the application and CV, e.g. CPR number, information about race, religion, trade union conditions, and health information. You can read about Omnidocs' guidelines for processing personal data here: https://omnidocs.com/processing-of-personal-data-in-the-context-of-recruitment/

HEGSØ Search & Consulting has the task of finding a skilled Machine Learning Engineer for our client, the leading subsea technology and development company Teledyne RESON.

Job Purpose:

Turn noisy, real-time sensor data into robust machine-learning solutions.

As Machine Learning Engineer you join a multidisciplinary engineering team developing ML for target detection, sonar imaging and pattern recognition in streaming acoustic data. Your work will connect sensors, signal processing, high-performance computing and the information ultimately presented to users.

The sensor systems generate large volumes of real-time data, which is transformed into software products for visualization, post-processing and analysis. The processing chain combines demanding real-time computation with FPGA, DSP and GPU hardware.

You will help develop both the ML models and the infrastructure around them. Because the ML infrastructure supports internal development and customer on-site use, robustness, efficiency and control are central to the role. You will work with industry-standard tools as well as in-house technology.

This is a rare opportunity to apply machine learning to difficult, meaningful data alongside maritime domain experts, software engineers, mathematical modelling engineers and embedded-processing specialists.

What makes the role distinctive:

• Challenging data – find structures and patterns in noisy streaming acoustic and hydrophone data

• End-to-end impact – work from sensor input and model development through to information presented to the user

• Industrial ML – turn novel ML technology into robust, efficient products for internal and customer use

Key Responsibilities:

• Develop machine-learning and data-science solutions for target detection in sonar acoustic data and imaging systems

• Identify structures and patterns in data from hydrophones

• Develop ML models and contribute to the ML infrastructure used in the software products

• Be an active member of a development team spanning software, mathematical modelling and dedicated embedded-processing hardware

• Communicate concepts across the development chain, from sensor input to the final information presented to the user

• Propose improvements to ML models and infrastructure

• Help bring novel ML technologies into robust, industrialized products

• Keep current with relevant technologies and tools

Essential skills:

• Experience with general machine-learning technologies, modern modelling techniques and deep-learning frameworks – PyTorch, TensorFlow or similar

• Understanding of software quality assurance principles and build tools, plus a successful track record in ML development

• Ability to manage and span substantial multi-year engineering efforts while contributing as a hands-on team player

• Strong technical communication skills and proficiency in English

Useful additional experience:

• A background in mathematics, physics or optics, with an understanding of the physics and nature of acoustics

• Experience with related signal-processing domains such as hearing aids, 5G telecom, radar or ultrasound

• Experience with relevant software and tools such as Git, Jira and build systems

Qualifications & Experience:

• An MSc or PhD in engineering is a strong foundation, but an experienced professional background can be equally relevant

• The right candidate may come from different disciplines and career paths

Behavioural Competencies:

• Self-driven, enjoys difficult technical challenges and keeps pushing toward ambitious goals

• Collaborates well and communicates well in a global team distributed between countries

• Takes ownership and responsibility, delivers to agreements and keeps promises

• Enthusiastic, energetic ‘can-do’ attitude

• Interested in new technologies, industry challenges and in the products, use cases, customers and the marine domain

What we offer:

• A collaborative workplace with strong colleagues and a company that takes good care of its employees

• A high level of ambition and the time to build high-quality products within a company recognized globally for world-class sonar systems

• A development path that supports your continued professional growth

• Interesting products, markets and customers, including leading research organizations, global industrial companies and defence organizations

About Teledyne RESON: Teledyne RESON is a world leader in high-quality underwater acoustic solutions – multibeam sonars, sensors, transducers and survey software. Founded in Denmark in 1976 and part of Teledyne since 2013, with headquarters, R&D and production in Slangerup.

Job location

Copenhagen, Denmark is preferred because close collaboration between ML and software engineers is important to the role.

If you want to know more, please contact:

Anders Hegelskov, HEGSØ Search & Consulting, Phone: +45 3035 6405 – Mail: ah@hegsoe.dk

jobs.occupation: Event & Experience Manager – Bring Axlab’s customer experiences to life
jobs.description:
Can you turn a showroom visit, a reference site tour or an industry exhibition into an experience that makes a lasting impression?

In collaboration with Actief Hartmanns, Axlab is looking for an Event & Experience Manager who combines creative design with hands-on delivery and a clear commercial focus.

In the position you will own Axlab’s customer-facing experience programme: reference site visits, the headquarters showroom, Axlab Academy, and industry exhibitions. This is an opportunity to combine concept development with practical execution, shaping how visitors experience Axlab’s solutions and building the calendar, materials and processes that ensure consistent quality and continuity.

Your role goes beyond logistics: you will design welcoming, relevant experiences that help visitors understand how Axlab’s solutions work in practice. You will also build the calendar, materials and documented processes that make the programme consistent, scalable, and less dependent on any one individual.

You will be part of the Marcom team and work closely with Sales, Product Management, and external partners. Together with the Graphic Designer & Event Coordinator, you will translate ideas into a strong exhibition presence and cohesive creative execution.

What you will take ownership of

• 
Develop and deliver reference site visits, showroom tours, Academy days and exhibitions that connect customer needs with Axlab’s automated pathology workflows.

• 
Establish and continually improve the showroom experience and reference site concept for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Manage programmes and events from concept to delivery, aligning internal teams, external agencies, and production partners.

• 
Build and maintain the activity calendar, supporting materials, briefings, and documented processes.

• 
Manage suppliers, budgets, and negotiations, with close attention to production details and on-site logistics.

• 
Track event performance and work with Sales and within Marcom to ensure effective lead handling and handover.

• 
Help support the development of a sustainable webinar approach that contributes to sales opportunities.

What you bring

You have at least five years of experience in event management, experiential marketing, or customer experience, ideally combining large-scale exhibitions with smaller, hosted experiences. Exhibition or trade show experience is essential, together with relevant experience from the medical device industry. You can demonstrate that you have designed and delivered premium customer or partner experiences, not simply coordinated the logistics.

• 
A bachelor’s degree or higher in marketing, communications, business, hospitality, or event management, or equivalent experience.

• 
Experience establishing and improving a showroom for a company providing anatomic pathology equipment or a medical device company.

• 
Experience developing and refining reference site concepts for prospective and existing customers.

• 
Strong end-to-end project management skills and the ability to collaborate with Sales, Product Management, and external partners.

• 
Experience managing vendors, suppliers, and budgets, including negotiations with agencies and production partners.

• 
Confidence reporting on event performance, handling leads and coordinates their handover.

• 
Fluency in English. Danish is an advantage when working with headquarters and the local reference site network.

Experience developing a webinar strategy that generates sales opportunities is a plus. Alternatively, you are comfortable learning this skill quickly, as you will work closely with your future colleagues in Marcom on this.

Regular travel should be expected, and in busy periods, this can be 50% or more.

A thoughtful host with a hands-on mindset

You make people feel genuinely welcome and adapt naturally to different visitors and situations. You stay calm when plans change, take pride in the details and are just as comfortable shaping an experience concept as managing the on-site logistics. Open and approachable, you build trust with colleagues, suppliers and senior stakeholders, communicate clear briefs, and know who needs which information — and when.

You bring creativity, initiative and a collaborative approach. You are curious about what works, use data and feedback to improve the programme and look for ways to make each visit or event meaningful rather than routine.

Axlab’s Marcom team works to build recognition of the Axlab brand for bringing innovation and automation to pathology laboratories in its direct markets. Through consistent brand storytelling, impactful events, customer experiences and digital channels, the team connects colleagues and customers with that ambition. In this role, you will have ownership of the experiences that show what it means in practice.

What we offer

We are a small yet ambitious growth company where our shared values — Decency, Innovation, Commitment, and Responsibility — form the foundation of everything we do. We offer a flexible, hybrid, and trust-based full-time position where you will have influence on both your own role and the continued development of our Marcom function . Occasional travel activity must be expected as part of the role.

• 
Competitive salary and employment conditions

• 
A highly visible role with direct access to senior leadership

• 
Influence on business decisions and strategic initiatives

• 
Professional and personal development opportunities

• 
An international and collaborative working environment

• 
Welcoming and comfortable office space with everyday perks including free refreshments and daily lunch buffet

• 
Social activities and annual global events

Your main contribution will be a robust financial, operations, tax and internal controls framework relevant to Zealand Pharma, leading to a successful external audit.

The position combines hands-on accounting with process ownership, giving you the opportunity to shape how financial operations scale in a growing biotechnology company. **

• Own inventory accounting, including valuation, cost accounting and period-end reconciliations

• Manage tax and VAT accounting, including reconciliations, reporting and compliance support

• Take a leading part in our SAF-T and ViDA reporting readiness, from process design and implementation through to optimization

• Oversee bank and treasury accounting, including cash, foreign exchange and investment transactions

• Manage intercompany accounting, including transactions and recharges

• Take part in building and continuously improve a robust financial operations, tax and internal controls framework

• Prepare for and support the external audit, working toward a successful outcome

**Your profile

• Experience from implementing and optimizing finance processes, ideally in connection with SAF-T, ViDA or similar tax reporting requirements

• Analytical skills and fluent written and spoken English

**Your new team

We work closely with colleagues across the organization and take pride in clear processes, strong controls and continuous improvement.

Let’s bond and be bold

We have a unique culture, characterized by excellent teamwork and strong engagement across the organization. And we want you to help us strengthen this culture.

Making bonds is at the core of everything we do. From discovering and developing the best new peptide drugs for patients, to engaging with our partners or connecting with each other. **Zealand Pharma A/S (Nasdaq: ZEAL) is a biotechnology company focused on advancing medicines for obesity and metabolic health. Combining more than 25 years of peptide R&D expertise with a proprietary data platform that leverages advanced datadriven and AI/ML approaches, Zealand Pharma aims to lead a new era in obesity and metabolic health. We do it by applying our knowledge and curiosity – and sometimes even our courage – to create the solutions the world needs today to enable a better tomorrow. We support our customers’ transition towards increased sustainability. We strive to lead by example by embedding environmental management, social responsibility and good governance into our business practices and the options we provide to our customers.

We value differences and development and cultivate an environment of belonging and having fun. Because that is what brings out the best in you, at work and at home.

With offices primarily located in the Nordic region, the UK, North America and India, we are currently more than 7,500 people who bring their expertise in engineering, architecture, energy and environment into play.

Get to know us even better at our website, www.cowi.com, where you can learn more about our projects, our strategy, what we want to achieve and what life is like at COWI.

**Before you apply

**All you need to include in your application is your CV – no photo or application letter. At an interview, you can tell us everything we need to know about why you’re interested in joining COWI. As for the photo, we prefer to form our first impression in person rather than from a picture.

**Diversity is fundamental to COWI, inclusion is key

**We are committed to creating a respectful and fair work environment where all employees have a sense of belonging and equitable opportunities to thrive and grow. We ensure that our leaders are role models for inclusive leadership by cultivating a culture where diverse perspectives and thoughts are seen as strengths. And we take diversity and inclusion into account in all relevant decisions and processes and when setting teams and fora. We do it because it is part of our values and because it is simply the right thing to do.

**Do you want to keep projects on track through effective coordination and high-quality documentation? Can you combine attention to detail with an overview of tasks, processes and deadlines? And do you have experience supporting project managers? Then join COWI as our new Project Coordinator!

****Create the solutions that will enable a better tomorrow

**We are looking for a Project Coordinator to join COWI and support our customers’ construction and operational projects. You will help ensure that work follows the applicable project model and act as a sparring partner to project managers and provide coordination, administrative support and document management across assignments.

Your key responsibilities will be:

• Take responsibility for project documentation, including preparing documents, reviewing and revising documentation, and ensuring it is archived in accordance with agreed rules.

• Maintain project registers to support progress and results, and share lessons learned about document management across the organisation.

• Act as a sparring partner to the project manager, assist with financial follow-up, and on your own coordinate, carry out and complete ad hoc tasks to relieve the project manager

• Plan, facilitate and report on workshops, and organise meetings, prepare agendas and write minutes.

• Develop process diagrams and guidance for project participants, and create, design and administer project workspaces.

• Train and support users of project-related tools and prepare status reports and project website content.

Your official COWI office location will be either Lyngby, Vejle or Aarhus. However, your primary workplace will be at Energinet in Erritsø, but Ballerup could also be an option, with some travel to Erritsø. You will report to Head of Discipline, Ioana Nicoleta Tuglui, who is based at COWI's headquarter in Lyngby.

**Your skills. Our team. Together we design the future.

**You enjoy collaborating with colleagues and external partners and bring a proactive and positive approach to your work. As the project’s administrative anchor, you are approachable, service-minded and flexible, while standing firm on quality requirements for processes and deliverables. You work in a structured way, maintaining an overview without losing sight of the details. You are curious about new tasks and also comfortable with routine work forming a substantial part of your day.

On top of that, you will have:

• Proficiency in Danish and English, both written and spoken.

• Experience with document management and an understanding of its importance to project quality and handover.

• Experience from a similar role in project coordination or project administration.

• An aptitude for IT, the ability to work across administrative systems, a good understanding of Microsoft Office and familiarity with SAP

• The ability to organise and see tasks through from start to finish, working with both internal colleagues and external partners.

**A Snapshot of Your Day

**Join Siemens Energy as a Product Manager with a strong focus on Wind Power and SCADA systems, where you act as the key link between business needs and agile development teams. Ideally, you have knowledge from the energy sector - maybe you even have a hands-on understanding of how wind farm operators work and the daily challenges they face, translating this into scalable and maintainable digital solutions. You operate across both strategic and operational levels – shaping product direction while working closely with teams to ensure efficient delivery. Your soft skills are strong and you know how to navigate having many different stakeholders in a dynamic environment, as well as manage both upwards, sideways and downwards. You are the type of person that takes ownership, and with a pragmatic mindset, you balance innovation, cost awareness, and technical feasibility to deliver competitive solutions that create real business value.

**How You'll Make An Impact

**

• Act as Product Manager for OT software and SCADA-related solutions, owning prioritization and value delivery across agile teams

• Translate real-world wind farm operational challenges into product requirements, ensuring solutions are practical and customer-focused

• Balance strategic roadmap ownership with hands-on involvement in agile delivery teams

• Drive prioritization based on business value, cost efficiency, and technical feasibility

• Identify technology trends and partnerships that support scalable, maintainable, and competitive solutions

**What You Bring

**

• Master’s degree in software engineering or similar combined with strong experience in Wind Power SCADA systems and OT environments

• Hands-on understanding of wind farm operations and the challenges faced by operators and service organizations

• Proven experience working both strategically and operationally within Product Management or similar roles

• Strong business mindset with focus on cost efficiency, maintainability, and pragmatic decision-making

• Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills across technical and business domains

**Who is Siemens Energy?

**At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. With +100,000 dedicated employees in more than 90 countries, we develop the energy systems of the future, ensuring that the growing energy demand of the global community is met reliably and sustainably. The technologies created in our research departments and factories drive the energy transition and provide the base for one sixth of the world's electricity generation.

Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation. Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemensenergy.com/employeevideo

**Our Commitment to Diversity

**Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity, we generate power. We run on inclusion and our combined creative energy is fueled by over 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society, all of society, and we do not discriminate based on our differences.
